_doc: Known differences between our emit and upstream's for the emit-snapshot samples, read by scripts/diff-upstream-emit.mjs. Hand-written only. `status: intended` = equivalent or deliberate, with the reason; `status: bug` = a real divergence still to fix (kept so the gate passes, and reported as stale once the fix makes it match). Match fields: `sample` (exact or `*`), `kind`, optional `label`, and `ours` / `upstream` substrings of the normalised text.

entries.reason: Same rewrite, different stage: like svelte2tsx's rewriteExternalImports, we rewrite a `../` specifier that leaves the workspace so it resolves from the overlay's directory, and leave every other relative specifier to the overlay tsconfig's `rootDirs`. We do it when the overlay is written (`rewrite_external_imports` in crates/typecheck/src/path_utils.rs), after the point where `--emit-ts` prints, so the snapshot shows the specifier as written.

Same code, unnormalised names: the components inside the `{#snippet}` prop are part of the outer component's text, and there upstream's locals `$$_egdaBnottuB0C` / `$$_tnenopmoC0` keep their names (the normaliser renames only constructor locals ending in `C<n>C`), and upstream leaves the closing tag's name `Component` as a bare expression statement. Neither changes a type; the `slot` prop and the named-slot destructure match.
